_about: Catalog of video effects: name, category, what it does and its tunable parameters. Shader code is not included.

effects.name: AI Portrait Matte
effects.description: Extracts a portrait as transparency using a cached AI matte.

effects.name: AI Smart Object Matte
effects.description: Select objects in the preview and track their alpha matte.

effects.name: Ape Face
effects.description: A broad muzzle with plump lips and nose plus visibly enlarged eyes (猩猩脸).

effects.name: ASCII Rain
effects.description: Blue glowing ASCII characters rain down over the bright areas of the video.

effects.name: Awkward
effects.description: A cartoon pear-shaped face with a stretched rubber mouth, tall worried eyes and tiny sweat drops (尴尬住了).

effects.name: Big Head
effects.description: Enlarge the head with a continuous face-following warp that smoothly deforms nearby background pixels.

effects.name: Big Mouth Monkey
effects.description: An oversized rubbery mouth and round magnified eyes follow the face and preserve speech motion (大嘴猴).

effects.name: Brain Confusion
effects.description: A hand-drawn thought bubble with changing tangled lines follows the face (大脑混乱).

effects.name: Canon Log3 to Canon 709
effects.description: Canon Cinema Gamut / Canon Log 3 to Canon 709

effects.name: Circle Mask
effects.description: Masks the layer with a soft-edged circle, with adjustable center, radius, feathering, and invert.

effects.name: Color Wheels
effects.description: Balance shadows, midtones, and highlights with Lift, Gamma, and Gain color wheels.

effects.name: Cool Red Eye
effects.description: A red-white eye glint with a long red lens flare attached to one eye (拽酷红眼).

effects.name: CRT Retro
effects.description: Simulates a retro CRT tube monitor with scanlines, screen curvature, RGB shift, noise, and vignette.

effects.name: Custom Curves
effects.description: Shape RGB and luminance, or selectively adjust hue, saturation and luminance with editable hue curves.

effects.name: Dome Magnifier
effects.description: Magnifies a circular region with a smooth dome-shaped lens distortion and no visible border.

effects.name: Doubt
effects.description: Two flat angular question marks attach to the head in 3D and project with its pose (疑问).

effects.name: Loading…
effects.description: A grey loading spinner follows a forehead attachment while remaining a screen-facing circle (宕机中).

effects.name: Face Laser Eyes
effects.description: Laser beams attached to source face landmarks

effects.name: Face Tracking Zoom
effects.description: Timeline zoom animation focused on detected faces

effects.name: autothreshold
effects.description: Automatically threshold moving pictures

effects.name: c0rners
effects.description: Four corners geometry engine

effects.name: Camera Shake Ultimate
effects.description: Camera movement effect with rotation, opacity, and blur.

effects.name: Cartoon
effects.description: Cartoonify video, do a form of edge detect

effects.name: Color Distance
effects.description: Calculates the distance between the selected color and the current pixel and uses that value as new pixel value

effects.name: colorhalftone
effects.description: Filters image to resemble a halftone print in which tones are represented as variable sized dots

effects.name: Defish0r
effects.description: Non rectilinear lens mappings

effects.name: dither
effects.description: Dithers the image and reduces the number of available colors

effects.name: Edgeglow
effects.description: Edgeglow filter

effects.name: Elastic scale filter
effects.description: This is a frei0r filter which allows one to scale video footage non-linearly.

effects.name: emboss
effects.description: Creates embossed relief image of source image

effects.name: Flippo
effects.description: Flipping in x and y axis

effects.name: Glow
effects.description: Creates a Glamorous Glow

effects.name: heatmap0r
effects.description: Performs a continuous trichromatic tinting

effects.name: Lens Correction
effects.description: Allows compensation of lens distortion

effects.name: LetterB0xed
effects.description: Adds Black Borders at top and bottom for Cinema Look

effects.name: NDVI filter
effects.description: This filter creates a false image from a visible + infrared source.

effects.name: nosync0r
effects.description: broken tv

effects.name: Perspective
effects.description: Distorts the image for a pseudo perspective

effects.name: pixeliz0r
effects.description: Pixelize input image.

effects.name: posterize
effects.description: Posterizes image by reducing the number of colors used in image

effects.name: primaries
effects.description: Reduce image to primary colors

effects.name: rgbsplit0r
effects.description: RGB splitting and shifting

effects.name: scanline0r
effects.description: interlaced dark lines

effects.name: Sharpness
effects.description: Unsharp masking (port from Mplayer)

effects.name: sigmoidaltransfer
effects.description: Desaturates image and creates a particular look that could be called Stamp, Newspaper or Photocopy

effects.name: Sobel
effects.description: Sobel filter

effects.name: softglow
effects.description: Does softglow effect on highlights

effects.name: Squareblur
effects.description: Variable-size square blur

effects.name: threelay0r
effects.description: dynamic 3 level thresholding

effects.name: Threshold0r
effects.description: Thresholds a source image

effects.name: Twolay0r
effects.description: dynamic thresholding

effects.name: Gaunt
effects.description: Two heavy blue comic stickers (憔悴 and 疲惫) follow the crown and temple while blue-grey sweat drops drift and fade (憔悴).

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.description: Applies an adjustable Gaussian blur in all directions or along a chosen angle, with an opacity mix.

effects.name: Graffiti Ghost
effects.description: A black portrait silhouette wears a glowing green razor-toothed grin, star eyes and head-attached horns (涂鸦鬼影).

effects.name: Hair Regions
effects.description: Tint source hair segmentation regions

effects.name: Hand Landmarks
effects.description: Display source hand landmarks

effects.name: Highlight
effects.description: A golden radial backdrop glows around the subject while a white hand-drawn outline traces the silhouette (高光时刻).

effects.name: Inspiration
effects.description: A single gold-white electric burst flashes beside the head with a right-side glint and a brief dark atmosphere (灵机一动).

effects.name: Laser Eyes
effects.description: Golden beams follow head direction, diverge outward from each eye and fill the eyelids

effects.name: Lightning Eyes
effects.description: Concentrated white-gold eye lights with a warm bloom and short flickering electric arcs around the eyes and temples (闪电眼).

effects.name: Linear Mask
effects.description: Masks the layer with a directional, piecewise-linear opacity gradient controlled by 2 to 8 stops.

effects.name: Local Mosaic
effects.description: Pixelates a rectangular region of the frame with adjustable position, size, block size, and feathered edges.

effects.name: Lost
effects.description: A black orbit with cyan, yellow and white 迷茫 lettering and colored stars revolves around the crown, following head pose with rear occlusion.

effects.name: Black Overlay (Screen)
effects.description: Overlays black-background footage (fire, smoke, light leaks, particles) by turning black transparent and keeping bright areas, like a Screen blend mode.

effects.name: LUT
effects.description: Apply a LUT file

effects.name: Magnifying Glass
effects.description: Adds a circular lens that magnifies the area at the chosen center point, ringed by a white border.

effects.name: Mask
effects.description: Combine ordered timed masks and hand correction layers, then stroke the completed mask.

effects.name: Person Focus
effects.description: A soft circular spotlight follows the face while the surroundings darken (人物聚焦).

effects.name: Person Regions
effects.description: Tint source person segmentation regions

effects.name: Body Landmarks
effects.description: Display source body landmarks

effects.name: Question Marks
effects.description: Five yellow comic question marks pop in and wobble along a face-following arch (一脸问号).

effects.name: Rectangle Mask
effects.description: Masks the layer to a rounded rectangle with adjustable size, corner radius, and feathered edges.

effects.name: Red Hot Face
effects.description: A continuously enlarged head turns hot red within the tracked face contour (红温大头).

effects.name: Sad
effects.description: Two long blue cartoon tear streams fall below the eyes while outlined Chinese comic words scroll behind the subject (难过).

effects.name: Camera Shake
effects.description: Adds handheld camera motion with fbm-noise jitter, rotation, zoom, and a subtle breathing pulse.

effects.name: Gloomy
effects.description: Purple dizzy spiral clouds float above the head and follow it (衰).

effects.name: Sony S-Log3 s709
effects.description: Sony S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine to Rec.709

effects.name: Stone
effects.description: The subject petrifies into grayscale stone with a broad open zigzag crack while the background keeps its color (石化了).

effects.name: Surprise
effects.description: Two golden comic exclamation marks attach beside the temples and follow head pose (惊讶).

effects.name: Really Thanks
effects.description: An exaggerated wide low mouth, swollen cheeks and chin, lifted worried upper face, and a large glossy blue sweat drop anchored to the forehead (真的会谢).

effects.name: Tilt-Shift
effects.description: Simulates a miniature/tilt-shift lens with a focused band, falloff blur, boosted saturation, and vignette.

effects.name: Is Something Wrong
effects.description: A helpless worried face with sloping brows, pinched outer eyes, a small forced smile, fuller cheeks and chin, and six translucent beads attached across the top of the head (有事吗？).

effects.name: Zoom
effects.description: Timeline zoom animation
